ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account action against the driver.
ruling.reasoning:
The rider disputes a $6.61 cancellation fee after the driver cancelled the RydeX trip from Jurong East MRT to NUS [F4][F7]. NS-0 is satisfied: the trip was cancelled by the driver and the driver claims the rider was a no-show, so the case runs through NS-1 / NS-2 [F4][F12][NS-0].

NS-1 requires three elements to be met together before the $6.61 fee can stand against the rider. (i) An arrival confirmation exists: the record shows a driver_tap at 21:29:45 [F6][NS-1]. (ii) At the moment of that tap the driver was inside the pickup radius — 41 m from the pickup point [F6], with a closest approach of 3 m [F1] — so the location element of NS-1(ii) is met [F6][F1][NS-1]. (iii) The driver must then have waited continuously at the pickup for more than 3 minutes until cancelling [NS-1]. The record shows he stayed within 200 m for only 1 min 45 s (105 s) after the tap [F6], and the platform recorded arrival at 21:28:35 with cancellation 2 min 55 s later [F5]. Cumulative time within 200 m before cancellation was 2 min 55 s [F2], still short of the 3:01 threshold. Element (iii) therefore fails [F2][F5][F6][NS-1].

Because one of the NS-1 elements fails, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full to the rider [F7][NS-2]. The trace confirms no fake arrival confirmation (the tap was inside the radius), so the additional flag_account condition in NS-2 is not triggered by that branch [F6][F1][NS-2]. The driver's written claim that he "waited at least 5 minutes" [F12] conflicts with the GPS and timeline records, and system records control: the driver is not to be penalised for a fake confirmation, but his verbal assertion cannot establish the wait [F2][F5][F6][NS-1]. The profiles (rider 0 disputes in 90 d; driver 0 disputes upheld in 90 d) [F16][F17] cannot decide the case and, since nothing is upheld against the driver, the RD-6/NS-2 account-action conditions are not met [F17][NS-2].

Safety screen: I read chat #1 ("I'm here, white BYD e6.") [F9], chat #2 ("Cancelling, waited too long") [F10], the complaint, and the driver's statement [F12]. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation in any of them; the exchange is a routine no-show dispute, so safety_concern is "none" [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1].

The record is complete: the full GPS trace covers the wait without a hole [F2][F6], the connection is timestamped and no gap is asserted for the no-show elements [F11], so the evidence settles every element of the ruling and the amount follows directly from the fare record [F7][NS-2][NS-7].
